text:
Aisha Khan: Hi all, Aisha here (infra eng) 9am first day. Trying to follow the quickstart but I can't spin up an instance in eu-west1. AWS console seems ok, but GCP returns 403 when I try `gcloud compute instances create demo-vm --zone=eu-west1-b --project=redwood-platform`. Error: `PERMISSION_DENIED: The caller does not have permission`

Marta Li: welcome Aisha! :wave: which project id are you using? are you on the onboarding group?

Aisha Khan: project is `redwood-platform`. I was added to `onboarding@redwood.com` mailing list but not sure if that maps to IAM groups. I also can't see billing account details in the console.

Samir Rao: quick checklist: 1) confirm you're in the right IAM group (we use `group:dev-onboard@redwood.com` for sandbox), 2) billing must be linked to the project for some APIs, 3) for eu-west1 you need compute network and region quotas.

DevOps Bot: INFO: New user onboarding started for aisha.khan@redwood.com. Provisioning checklist ticket created: ONBOARD-4512.

Marta Li: @cloud-ops can you confirm if `redwood-platform` is attached to `billing-sandbox-003` or `billing-prod-001`? For new hires we attach sandbox.

cloud-ops: linked `billing-sandbox-003` to project `redwood-platform` at 2025-06-12T09:05:00Z.

Aisha Khan: thanks, re-ran the gcloud command and now I get `PermissionDenied: The caller does not have permission to perform compute.instances.create`. Looks like IAM still missing.

Samir Rao: I'll add you to the minimal onboarding role set: `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1` and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser`. If you need to manage networks as well we'll add `roles/compute.networkAdmin`. Do you need to create subnets?

Aisha Khan: just need to boot a test VM, so instanceAdmin is enough for now. Thanks.

Samir Rao: done. You should receive an email; try now.

Aisha Khan: instance create worked! :tada: One follow-up: how do I request additional CPUs in eu-west1 if I hit quota?

Marta Li: follow the quota request doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/cloud/quota-request. Short version: open CH-ops ticket with project id, region, SKU (e.g., CPUS), and justification. Tag `priority:onboarding` for faster handling.

Aisha Khan: perfect, I'll file that if needed. Thanks everyone for the quick help.
